title: Settings
subtitle: Manage your business settings and preferences

calendar.title: Business Calendar
calendar.subtitle: Opening hours, cut-off and holidays. Promised ready times are worked out from these.
calendar.timezone: Time zone: {timezone}. Change it in General settings.
calendar.movedFromGeneral: Opening hours are now set on the Business Calendar page, with cut-off time, ready time and holidays.

cutoff.label: Cut-off time
cutoff.help: Orders received after this time count from the next working day. Empty = no cut-off.

ready.label: Ready time
ready.help: When orders promised in working days are ready. Empty = closing time.

branch.emptyDescription: Each branch can use the organization's calendar or its own.

holidays.name: Name (English)
holidays.deleteDescription: Promised ready times will treat this date as a normal day. Saved orders do not change.
holidays.noPublicYear: No public holiday dates are loaded for {country} in {year}. Ask the platform team to add them; until then ready times ignore public holidays.
holidays.emptyDescription: Add the days you close, or short working days.
holidays.noCountry: Public holidays cannot be shown because the organization has no country.

validation.closeAfterOpen: Enter both times; closing must be after opening.
validation.name: Enter a name of up to 200 characters.

warnings.title: Check these times
warnings.CUTOFF_BEFORE_OPENING: The cut-off is at or before opening, so every order is counted from the next working day.
warnings.CUTOFF_AFTER_CLOSING: The cut-off is at or after closing, so it never applies.
warnings.READY_OUTSIDE_HOURS: The ready time is outside the opening hours, so promised times are cut to closing time or start at opening.

preview.title: If an order is placed now
preview.subtitle: From the saved settings, in the same way order entry promises a ready time. Standard is shown for an item that takes 24 working hours.
preview.hours: {count, plural, one {# working hour} other {# working hours}}
preview.days: {count, plural, one {# working day} other {# working days}}
preview.notConfigured: Set the opening hours (and the organization time zone) to see ready times. Until then orders count clock hours, including closed days.
preview.loadFailed: Could not load the preview. Refresh the page to try again.

template.filled: Template values loaded. Review them, then press Save.

discard.title: Discard your changes?
discard.description: This branch has unsaved changes. Switching branch discards them.

errors.title: Could not save

errors.CALENDAR_INVALID_HOURS: Check the hours: closing must be after opening, and at least one day must be open.
errors.HOLIDAY_DUPLICATE: This date already has a holiday for the same branch.
errors.INVALID_REFERENCE: The selected branch is not available.
errors.CSRF_REJECTED: Your session needs refreshing. Reload the page and try again.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some values are not valid. Check them and try again.

tenantSettings.title: Tenant Settings
tenantSettings.description: Configure organization-wide settings and pricing modes
tenantSettings.pricingDescription: Control how tax and extra prices are applied across all orders for this tenant

branchSettings.title: Branch Settings
branchSettings.description: Configure settings per branch. Each branch can override the tenant-level defaults.
branchSettings.pricingDescription: Override pricing modes for this branch. Select "Inherit from tenant" to use the tenant default.

businessDay.title: Business day
businessDay.description: The timezone that decides this branch’s business date and when a POS session rolls over at the end of the day.
businessDay.label: Branch timezone
businessDay.noPermission: You need the settings update permission to change the timezone.
businessDay.changeNote: Sessions already open keep the business date they opened with. New sessions, and the next rollover check, use the new timezone.
businessDay.missingBody: Neither this branch nor the organization has a valid timezone, so POS sessions cannot be opened here. Choose a timezone.
businessDay.saveFailed: Failed to update the branch timezone
businessDay.loadFailed: Failed to load the timezone settings

pricingMode.taxPricingModeDesc: How tax is applied to order items
pricingMode.extraPricePricingModeDesc: How extra prices are presented on orders
pricingMode.taxExclusiveDesc: Tax is added on top of the item price
pricingMode.taxInclusiveDesc: Tax is embedded within the item price
pricingMode.includedInItemPriceDesc: Extra price is part of the item total
pricingMode.separateChargeDesc: Extra price is shown as a separate line item
pricingMode.inheritNote: Leave unset to inherit from tenant
pricingMode.managedByPlatform: Managed by platform administration. Contact your platform administrator to change it.
